author: Twillion
name: AutoMeshLOD3D
shortDescription: Automated runtime single-mesh Level of Detail (LOD) simplification and throttling with Web Worker decimation and shared GPU vertex memory.
description:
**AutoMeshLOD3D** is an automated Level of Detail (LOD) extension for **GDevelop 5 (WebGL2 / Three.js backend)**.

Instead of requiring 3D artists to manually create, decimate, and export multiple .glb models in Blender, AutoMeshLOD3D takes a single 3D model and automatically generates optimized lower-polygon index buffers in the background at runtime.

### Key Highlights:
- **1 Single Model In → Multi-Tier LOD Out:** No manual multi-asset authoring required.
- **Shared Vertex Memory:** All LOD levels share the original vertex positions, UV coordinates, normals, and skeletal bone weights—saving up to 70% VRAM compared to traditional multi-mesh LOD.
- **Asynchronous Web Worker Processing:** Quadric Error Metric (QEM) edge collapse decimation runs in background worker threads with zero 60 FPS frame drops during scene loading.
- **Skeletal Rig Preservation:** Simplifies animated characters without breaking skin weights or bone bindings.
- **Unified Multi-Throttling:** Automatically couples geometry decimation with shadow cutoff and distant skeletal animation tick throttling.
- **Sniper & FOV-Proof:** Supports projected screen-pixel coverage evaluation so zoomed-in models never look low-poly.

eventsFunctions.name: SetGlobalLODBias
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set global 3D LOD distance bias to _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Multiplies all LOD distances across the scene by a global bias (e.g. 1.5 for high-end PCs, 0.7 for mobile).

events.inlineCode: if (gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D) gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D.setGlobalLODBias(eventsFunctionContext.getArgument("Bias"));

eventsFunctions.name: PrecomputeLOD
eventsFunctions.sentence: Precompute AutoMesh LOD index buffers for _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Immediately extracts and submits object geometry to the worker queue at level start.

eventsFunctions.name: ClearLODCache
eventsFunctions.sentence: Clear AutoMesh LOD shared geometry cache
eventsFunctions.description: Clears the in-memory shared index buffer cache to free RAM.

events.inlineCode: if (gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D) gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D.clearLODCache();

eventsFunctions.name: GetPendingJobCount
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of mesh decimation tasks currently queued in the background worker pool.

events.inlineCode: eventsFunctionContext.returnValue = gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D ? gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D.getPendingJobCount() : 0;

eventsFunctions.name: GetTotalTrianglesSaved
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the real-time sum of triangles saved across all active AutoMeshLOD3D instances in the scene.

events.inlineCode: eventsFunctionContext.returnValue = gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D ? gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D.getTotalTrianglesSaved() : 0;

eventsFunctions.name: GetGlobalLODBias
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the current global LOD distance bias multiplier.

events.inlineCode: eventsFunctionContext.returnValue = gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D ? gdjs.__autoMeshLOD3D.getGlobalLODBias() : 1.0;

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AutoMeshLOD3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Automated runtime single-mesh Level of Detail (LOD) decimation and multi-tier throttling for GDevelop 3D models. Generates low-poly index buffers in background Web Workers while sharing GPU vertex memory.

propertyDescriptors.name: Enabled
propertyDescriptors.label: Enabled
propertyDescriptors.description: Enable or disable dynamic LOD evaluation.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD1Distance
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD 1 Distance (m)
propertyDescriptors.description: Camera distance (in meters) to trigger Level 1 simplification.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD1Ratio
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD 1 Triangle Ratio
propertyDescriptors.description: Target triangle ratio for LOD 1 (0.5 = 50% of original triangles).

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD2Distance
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD 2 Distance (m)
propertyDescriptors.description: Camera distance (in meters) to trigger Level 2 simplification.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD2Ratio
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD 2 Triangle Ratio
propertyDescriptors.description: Target triangle ratio for LOD 2 (0.2 = 20% of original triangles).

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowCutoffDistance
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Cutoff Distance (m)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance beyond which real-time shadow casting (castShadow) is disabled.

propertyDescriptors.name: EvaluationMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Evaluation Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Evaluation method: Linear Euclidean Distance or Projected Screen Pixel Coverage.

propertyDescriptors.name: ThrottleAnimation
propertyDescriptors.label: Throttle Skeletal Animation
propertyDescriptors.description: Throttle skeletal rig matrix updates for distant animated models (LOD1: 30 FPS, LOD2: 15 FPS).

propertyDescriptors.name: PreserveSeams
propertyDescriptors.label: Preserve UV & Boundary Seams
propertyDescriptors.description: Strictly preserve UV and material seam boundaries during edge collapse.

propertyDescriptors.name: DebugLogs
propertyDescriptors.label: Debug Console Logs
propertyDescriptors.description: Log real-time LOD tier transitions, face counts, and decimation benchmarks to the browser/GDevelop developer console.
